'''Renan bloodwolves''' were a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rena (planet)|Rena]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] once captured a bloodwolf as part of his collection of [[Tooth/Legends|dental]] specimens. Mountain ranges above the Renan vineyards were home to this species, which stood just under a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall at its shoulder. Its two pair of slashing teeth were abnormally large compared to its skull.<ref name="TTBS" /> These creatures had long dense fur,<ref name="TTBS" /> silvery<ref name="LW" /> and mottled in broad patches for camouflage.<ref name="TTBS" /> Mature bloodwolves' tooth enamel was a dusky red-brown caused by [[Iron/Legends|iron]] deposits in the outer layer.<ref name="TTBS" /><ref name="LW" /> Bloodwolves fed on spiny [[hordzat]]s and hunted [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] in packs.<ref name="LW" />

This predator was revered by [[Pipunt]] people, who called it the "Great Beast Prince". Renan bloodwolves were known to fiercely protect their young. The brood-fathers of packs could fight to death to protect their offspring — or, when it looked a more secure way to save a cub, could take it into their jaws and run from danger at a speed up to eighty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] (though sometimes during such escapes cubs got killed in their powerful jaws by accident).<ref name="LW" />
